cases.name: successful-result

cases.name: generic-result

modules.main: function make<T:type>(value:T){return [value];}const a=make.<string>("s");const s:string=a[0];if(s!=="s")throw new Error("value");

cases.requirement: Generic signature instantiation preserves the array element.

cases.name: generic-captured-result

modules.main: function outer<T:type>(value:T){return function make(){const x:T=value;return [x];};}const make=outer.<string>("s");const a=make();const s:string=a[0];if(s!=="s")throw new Error("value");

cases.requirement: Nested callable result substitutes the captured type parameter.

cases.name: mutable-array-iterator-replacement

modules.main: function make(){const a:[].<string>=["s"];function replace(o:any){o[Symbol.iterator]=function*(){yield 1;};}replace(a);return [...a];}const a=make();if(a[0]!==1)throw new Error("iterator");

cases.requirement: A storage annotation cannot override the iterator actually selected at evaluation.

cases.name: mutable-tuple-iterator-replacement
cases.requirement: Tuple storage extent does not constrain iteration count or yielded values.

cases.name: array-const-receiving-boundary
cases.requirement: Inferred initialization preserves a conforming plain array; a later typed read must still enforce its established view.

cases.name: array-const-failed-read-recovery

modules.main: const x:string="s";const a=[x];function replace(o:any,v:any){o[0]=v;}replace(a,Symbol());let rejected=false;try{const s:string=a[0];}catch(e){if(!(e instanceof TypeError))throw e;rejected=true;}if(!rejected)throw new Error("read");replace(a,"t");const s:string=a[0];if(s!=="t")throw new Error("recovery");

cases.requirement: A failed inferred-view read does not poison a later valid read after a backing replacement.

cases.name: array-let-has-no-inferred-storage
cases.requirement: An ordinary unannotated let does not acquire inferred array storage.

cases.name: dynamic-extent
cases.requirement: Array literal length does not become a fixed extent.

cases.name: spread-effects-once

modules.main: let trace="";function make(){return [...{[Symbol.iterator]():{next():{done:boolean,value:string}}{trace+="i";let n=0;return {next(){trace+="n";n++;return {done:n>1,value:"s"};}};}}];}const a=make();if(trace!=="inn"||a[0]!=="s")throw new Error(trace);

cases.requirement: Static provenance adds no iterator lookup or step; evaluation invokes one iterator and two steps.

cases.name: imported-factory
cases.requirement: Published provenance crosses a module boundary without executing either body.

cases.name: imported-factory-valid

modules.main: import {make} from "dep";const a=make();const s:string=a[0];if(s!=="s")throw new Error("value");

cases.requirement: A valid imported result keeps its element contract.

cases.name: forward-dependency

modules.main: function make(){return later();}function later(){const x:string="s";return [x];}const n:number=make();

cases.requirement: Array provenance completes a forward result dependency before publication.

cases.name: reverse-dependency

modules.main: function later(){const x:string="s";return [x];}function make(){return later();}const n:number=make();

cases.requirement: Declaration order does not change contribution provenance.

cases.name: recursive-dependency

modules.main: const flag:any=false;function make(){if(flag)return again();const x:string="s";return [x];}function again(){return make();}const n:number=again();

cases.requirement: An independently anchored array contribution seeds a mutually recursive result cycle.

cases.name: array-const-receiving-conversion

modules.main: const x:string="s";const a=[x];function replace(o:any){o[0]=1;}replace(a);const s:string=a[0];function verify(v:any){if(typeof v!=="string"||v!=="1")throw new Error("conversion");}verify(s);

cases.requirement: The retained receiving boundary performs an admitted Number-to-String conversion after backing mutation.
